GraphNodeService（Python）

  • graph_node_id: The node ID of graph node in the parent graph Entrance: client.graph_node

New parameter format

The subgraph node interface now uses the SubGraph* parameter object uniformly: See: Python 参数对象 for complete field descriptions.

from atom_sdk import (
    ChangeSubGraphNodeIOParams,
    CreateDynamicSubGraphNodeParams,
    EditSubGraphNameParams,
    EditSubGraphNodeCommentParams,
    ExportSubGraphParams,
    SetSubgraphAsCustomSubgraphParams,
    SubGraphBindingUpdate,
    SubGraphConnectionParams,
    SubGraphCopyNodeParams,
    SubGraphCreateNodeParams,
    SubGraphNodeParamUpdate,
    SubGraphNodeRef,
    SubGraphPortRef,
    SubGraphRef,
)
method Parameter object

open_graph / run_graph

SubGraphRef

create_node

SubGraphCreateNodeParams

create_dynamic_io_node

CreateDynamicSubGraphNodeParams

create_node_by_copy

SubGraphCopyNodeParams

change_node_io

ChangeSubGraphNodeIOParams

delete_node / get_node_params / get_node_info_in_graph / activate_node / initial_node / update_node

SubGraphNodeRef

connect_nodes / disconnect_nodes

SubGraphConnectionParams

get_node_port_data / get_points_data / get_points_data_parsed / download_data

SubGraphPortRef

set_node_param_data

SubGraphNodeParamUpdate

set_binding_name

SubGraphBindingUpdate

edit_node_comment

EditSubGraphNodeCommentParams

edit_graph_name

EditSubGraphNameParams

export_graph

ExportSubGraphParams

set_subgraph_as_custom_subgraph

SetSubgraphAsCustomSubgraphParams

Recommended calling order

client.graph.open_graph(graph_name)                  <- Open the parent image first
        |
client.graph_node.open_graph(SubGraphRef(...))       <- open graph node Internal subgraph
        |
client.graph_node.create_node(SubGraphCreateNodeParams(...))
        |
client.graph_node.set_node_param_data(SubGraphNodeParamUpdate(...))
        |
client.graph_node.connect_nodes(SubGraphConnectionParams(...))
        |
client.graph_node.run_graph(SubGraphRef(...))

Interface detailed explanation

open_graph(params)

Open the internal subgraph corresponding to the specified graph node and cache timestamp.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphRef

field type Description

graph_name

str

Parent image name

graph_node_id

str

node ID in parent graph graph node

 
from atom_sdk import SubGraphRef

result = client.graph_node.open_graph(SubGraphRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123"))
print("Number of subgraph nodes:", len(result.get("graph", {}).get("nodes", [])))

create_node(params)

Create a node in the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphCreateNodeParams

field type Description

graph_name

str

Parent image name

graph_node_id

str

graph node node ID

node_name

str

The node class name to be created

 
from atom_sdk import SubGraphCreateNodeParams

result = client.graph_node.create_node(
    SubGraphCreateNodeParams(
        "my_graph",
        "gn_abc123",
        "PreprocessNode",
    )
)
sub_node_id = result["nodeId"]
print("Request status:", result["status"])

create_node_by_copy(params)

Copy existing nodes in the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphCopyNodeParams

field type Description

graph_name

str

Parent image name

graph_node_id

str

graph node node ID

node_name

str

The new node name after copying

node_id

str

The copied source node ID

 
from atom_sdk import SubGraphCopyNodeParams

result = client.graph_node.create_node_by_copy(
    SubGraphCopyNodeParams("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "PreprocessNode_2", "source_sub_node_id")
)
print("Request status:", result["status"])
print("Node after copying ID:", result["nodeId"])

create_dynamic_io_node(params)

Create nodes with dynamic input and output definitions in the subgraph.

from atom_sdk import CreateDynamicSubGraphNodeParams

result = client.graph_node.create_dynamic_io_node(
    CreateDynamicSubGraphNodeParams(
        "my_graph",
        "gn_abc123",
        "DynamicIONode",
        {"outputs": [{"name": "mask_out", "dtype": "BinaryImage"}]},
    )
)
print(result["nodeId"])

change_node_io(params)

Modify the input and output definitions of dynamic nodes in the subgraph.

from atom_sdk import ChangeSubGraphNodeIOParams

client.graph_node.change_node_io(
    ChangeSubGraphNodeIOParams(
        "my_graph",
        "gn_abc123",
        "sub_node_id",
        {"outputs": [{"name": "score_out", "dtype": "Float"}]},
    )
)

delete_node(params)

Delete a node in the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphNodeRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphNodeRef

client.graph_node.delete_node(
    SubGraphNodeRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id")
)

connect_nodes(params)

A port connecting two nodes in a subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphConnectionParams

field type Description

graph_name

str

Parent image name

graph_node_id

str

graph node node ID

output_node_id

str

Source node ID, which is the node that generates data

output_port_name

str

Source node output port name

input_node_id

str

Target node ID, which is the node that receives data

input_port_name

str

Target node input port name

Memory method: output_* in front, input_* in back. The data flow direction is output → input.

 
from atom_sdk import SubGraphConnectionParams

client.graph_node.connect_nodes(
    SubGraphConnectionParams(
        graph_name="my_graph",
        graph_node_id="gn_abc123",
        output_node_id="sub_node_a",
        output_port_name="image_out",
        input_node_id="sub_node_b",
        input_port_name="image_in",
    )
)

disconnect_nodes(params)

Break the connection between two nodes in the subgraph. The parameter object is the same as connect_nodes.

from atom_sdk import SubGraphConnectionParams

client.graph_node.disconnect_nodes(
    SubGraphConnectionParams(
        "my_graph",
        "gn_abc123",
        "sub_node_a",
        "image_out",
        "sub_node_b",
        "image_in",
    )
)

get_node_params(params)

Get the current parameter values ​​of nodes within the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphNodeRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphNodeRef

params = client.graph_node.get_node_params(
    SubGraphNodeRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id")
)
print(params.get("init_params"))

get_node_info_in_graph(params)

Get the complete information of a node in the subgraph, including parameters, ports and policy configuration.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphNodeRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphNodeRef

info = client.graph_node.get_node_info_in_graph(
    SubGraphNodeRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id")
)
print(info.get("nodeInfo"))

get_node_port_data(params)

Get the current data of a port of a node in the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphPortRef

field type Description

graph_name

str

Parent image name

graph_node_id

str

graph node node ID

node_id

str

Node ID in subgraph

port_name

str

Port name

io_type

str

port direction, usually "inputs" or "outputs"

 
from atom_sdk import SubGraphPortRef

data = client.graph_node.get_node_port_data(
    SubGraphPortRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id", "result_out", "outputs")
)
print(data)

get_points_data_parsed(params)

Read and parse subgraph node point clouds. Ordinary users give priority to using this interface.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphPortRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphPortRef

clouds = client.graph_node.get_points_data_parsed(
    SubGraphPortRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id", "cloud_out", "outputs")
)
print(clouds[0].shape)
print(clouds[0].tolist()[:2])

get_points_data(params)

Read the raw point cloud byte stream of the subgraph node port.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphPortRef Return value: bytes Note: What is returned here is Atom custom binary point cloud payload. When consuming point clouds normally, get_points_data_parsed(…​) is preferred.

from atom_sdk import SubGraphPortRef

raw = client.graph_node.get_points_data(
    SubGraphPortRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id", "cloud_out", "outputs")
)
print(len(raw))

download_data(params)

Generate server download links for subgraph node results.

from atom_sdk import SubGraphPortRef

result = client.graph_node.download_data(
    SubGraphPortRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id", "cloud_out", "outputs")
)
print(result["url"])

set_node_param_data(params)

Set node parameters within the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphNodeParamUpdate

field type Description

graph_name

str

Parent image name

graph_node_id

str

graph node node ID

node_id

str

Node ID in subgraph

param_name

str

Parameter name

param_type

str

parameter type, usually "init_params" or "run_params"

value

Any

parameter value; when pathlib.Path is passed in, SDK will automatically upload as a file

 
from atom_sdk import SubGraphNodeParamUpdate

client.graph_node.set_node_param_data(
    SubGraphNodeParamUpdate(
        "my_graph",
        "gn_abc123",
        "sub_node_id",
        "threshold",
        "run_params",
        0.8,
    )
)

set_binding_name(params)

Set the binding name for the port or parameter of the node within the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphBindingUpdate

field type Description

graph_name

str

Parent image name

graph_node_id

str

graph node node ID

node_id

str

Node ID in subgraph

binding_type

str

"inputs", "outputs", "init_params" or "run_params"

origin_name

str

Original port name or parameter name

binding_name

str

New binding name; passing an empty string usually means canceling the binding

 
from atom_sdk import SubGraphBindingUpdate

client.graph_node.set_binding_name(
    SubGraphBindingUpdate(
        "my_graph",
        "gn_abc123",
        "sub_node_id",
        "outputs",
        "detection_result",
        "sub_detect_out",
    )
)

edit_node_comment(params)

Modify the node remarks in the subgraph.

from atom_sdk import EditSubGraphNodeCommentParams

client.graph_node.edit_node_comment(
    EditSubGraphNodeCommentParams("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id", "New subplot notes")
)

get_graph_bindings(params)

Read the current binding status of the entire subgraph.

from atom_sdk import SubGraphRef

bindings = client.graph_node.get_graph_bindings(SubGraphRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123"))
print(bindings.get("outputs"))

get_graph_dl_nodes_model_info(params)

Get the model information associated with the deep learning node in the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphRef Return value: Model information mapping returned by the server.

from atom_sdk import SubGraphRef

models = client.graph_node.get_graph_dl_nodes_model_info(
    SubGraphRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123")
)
print(models)

get_graph_custom_nodes(params)

Get the custom node information used in the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphRef Return value: Custom node information mapping returned by the server.

custom_nodes = client.graph_node.get_graph_custom_nodes(
    SubGraphRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123")
)
print(custom_nodes)

edit_graph_name(params)

Modify the subgraph name.

from atom_sdk import EditSubGraphNameParams

client.graph_node.edit_graph_name(
    EditSubGraphNameParams("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "subgraph_v2")
)

export_graph(params)

Exports a graph node internal subgraph.

from atom_sdk import ExportSubGraphParams

result = client.graph_node.export_graph(
    ExportSubGraphParams("my_graph", "gn_abc123")
)
print(result.get("url"))

release_graph(params)

Release the subgraph corresponding to the specified graph node and clean up the server resources.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphRef

client.graph_node.clear_graph(SubGraphRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123"))
nodes_info = client.graph_node.get_all_nodes_info()
client.graph_node.release_graph(SubGraphRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123"))

Return value: The release result returned by the server, usually dict or a Boolean value.

clear_graph(params)

Clearing the intermediate data left behind by the previous run of the subgraph will not delete the subgraph structure.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphRef

result = client.graph_node.clear_graph(SubGraphRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123"))
print(result)

get_all_nodes_info()

Get all node definitions available in the subgraph editing scene. This interface does not bind a certain picture or a certain graph node. So no request parameters are required. Return value: dict[str, Any].

nodes_info = client.graph_node.get_all_nodes_info()
print("Number of available nodes:", len(nodes_info))

set_subgraph_as_custom_subgraph(params)

Save the current subgraph as a reusable custom subgraph template.

from atom_sdk import SetSubgraphAsCustomSubgraphParams

result = client.graph_node.set_subgraph_as_custom_subgraph(
    SetSubgraphAsCustomSubgraphParams("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "custom_subgraph_template")
)
print(result.get("customGraphName"))

activate_node(params, *, timeout_seconds=30)

Activate a node in the subgraph and its downstream nodes, automatically polling internally until completion or waiting timeout.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphNodeRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphNodeRef

result = client.graph_node.activate_node(
    SubGraphNodeRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id"),
    timeout_seconds=120,
)
print("Complete:", result.get("finish"))

timeout_seconds=None means waiting until the server returns completion or error.

initial_node(params)

Initialize a node in the subgraph.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphNodeRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphNodeRef

result = client.graph_node.initial_node(
    SubGraphNodeRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id")
)
print("Initialization successful:", result.get("success"))

update_node(params)

Update a single node in a subgraph. This interface is only requested once, and the finish status returned by the server will be handed over to the user as it is.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphNodeRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphNodeRef

result = client.graph_node.update_node(
    SubGraphNodeRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123", "sub_node_id")
)
print("Is this return completed?:", result.get("finish"))

run_graph(params, *, timeout_seconds=30)

Runs the entire subgraph, automatically polling internally until it completes or waits for a timeout.

Parameter Object:
SubGraphRef

from atom_sdk import SubGraphRef

result = client.graph_node.run_graph(SubGraphRef("my_graph", "gn_abc123"), timeout_seconds=120)
print("Request status:", result["status"])
print("Subgraph execution completed:", result.get("finish"))

timeout_seconds=None means waiting until the server returns completion or error.

The difference between GraphNodeService and NodeService

Comparison item NodeService GraphNodeService

Operation target

Nodes in the main graph

A node in a graph node internal subgraph

Entrance

client.node

client.graph_node

Parameter object

NodeRef, PortRef, etc.

SubGraphRef, SubGraphPortRef, etc.

Extra targeting fields

None

graph_node_id

Routing prefix

/Node/*

/GraphNode/*

Complete example

from atom_sdk import (
    AtomClient,
    SubGraphConnectionParams,
    SubGraphCreateNodeParams,
    SubGraphNodeParamUpdate,
    SubGraphRef,
)

client = AtomClient(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:10026")
GRAPH_NAME = "main_graph"
GRAPH_NODE_ID = "gn_abc123"

client.graph.open_graph(GRAPH_NAME)

sub_result = client.graph_node.open_graph(
    SubGraphRef(GRAPH_NAME, GRAPH_NODE_ID)
)
print("Number of subgraph nodes:", len(sub_result.get("graph", {}).get("nodes", [])))

resize = client.graph_node.create_node(
    SubGraphCreateNodeParams(GRAPH_NAME, GRAPH_NODE_ID, "ResizeImage")
)
resize_id = resize["nodeId"]
print("Resize Node creation request status:", resize["status"])

filter_node = client.graph_node.create_node(
    SubGraphCreateNodeParams(GRAPH_NAME, GRAPH_NODE_ID, "FilterNode")
)
filter_id = filter_node["nodeId"]
print("Filter Node creation request status:", filter_node["status"])

client.graph_node.set_node_param_data(
    SubGraphNodeParamUpdate(GRAPH_NAME, GRAPH_NODE_ID, resize_id, "scale_factor", "run_params", 0.5)
)

client.graph_node.connect_nodes(
    SubGraphConnectionParams(GRAPH_NAME, GRAPH_NODE_ID, resize_id, "resized_image", filter_id, "image_in")
)

result = client.graph_node.run_graph(SubGraphRef(GRAPH_NAME, GRAPH_NODE_ID))
print("Request status:", result["status"])
print("Subgraph execution completed:", result.get("finish"))
